items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 18 at 4:04PM EDT until October 22 at 6:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, 1 to 3 feet of inundation
above ground level in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal
waterways. For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 9
to 15 feet in the surf zone. For the Beach Hazards Statement,
dangerous rip currents, large breaking waves, and strong
longshore currents in the surf zone.

* WHERE...Northern Outer Banks.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Advisory, until 6 AM EDT Thursday.
For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 5 PM EDT Tuesday. For
the Beach Hazards Statement, until 8 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...1 to 3 feet of inundation above ground level is
expected in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways
resulting in a low threat of property damage. Some roads and low
lying property including parking lots, parks, lawns, and homes
adjacent to the waterfront will experience shallow flooding.
Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and localized beach
erosion. Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away from
shore into deeper water. Dangerous shore break can throw a
swimmer or surfer head first into the bottom causing neck and
back injuries. Strong longshore currents will create dangerous
swimming conditions.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Swimmers should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf
conditions.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 18 at 11:27AM EDT until October 20 at 6:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Hatteras Island, Northern Outer Banks, and Ocracoke Island.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM EDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 18 at 3:03PM EDT until October 22 at 6:00AM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and seas
11 to 16 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Duck to Ocracoke Inlet, and
the coastal waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Cape Lookout.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM EDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
